meta.name: md2wechat
meta.description: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML, inspect supported providers/themes/prompts, generate article images, create drafts, write with creator styles, prepare title suggestions, and remove AI writing traces.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将Markdown快速转为微信公众号文章
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要将Markdown稿件发布到微信公众号
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to WeChat Official Account articles quickly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often publish Markdown drafts to WeChat Official Account

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调用 md2wechat 命令行工具,把你的 Markdown 文章转成微信公众号 HTML;还能按你的要求生成配图、创建微信草稿、按指定风格写作、提供标题建议、去除 AI 写作痕迹。
howto.when: 当你说「把 Markdown 转成公众号 HTML」「生成配图/封面」「建议几个标题」等,或要求创建草稿、按风格改写、去除 AI 痕迹时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 Markdown 转成公众号 HTML
say.note: 执行转换并输出排版好的 HTML。

say.text: 给这篇文章建议三个标题
say.note: 生成标题候选,不会直接发布。

say.text: 把这段文字改得更像人写的
say.note: 调用 humanize 去除 AI 痕迹。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude uses the md2wechat CLI to convert your Markdown article into WeChat Official Account HTML. It can also generate images, create WeChat drafts, write in a chosen creator style, suggest titles, and remove AI writing traces on request.
howto.when_en: It triggers when you ask to convert Markdown to WeChat HTML, generate an image or cover, suggest titles, or request draft creation, style writing, or humanization.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown to WeChat Official Account HTML
say_en.note: Runs conversion and outputs formatted HTML.

say_en.text: Suggest three titles for this article
Rewrite this passage to sound more human
say_en.note: Calls humanize to remove AI traces.
